tagline: BadGuy is a multi-chain gas dealer protocol and enabling gas providers  earn profit.
description:
Multi-Chain Gas Dealer Protocol

We provide a seamless multi-chain gas solution that enables users to easily top up gas across multiple blockchain networks. Investors can participate by supplying gas liquidity and earn returns through profit sharing models, creating a win-win ecosystem for both users and providers.

Our platform ensures:

Ease of Use: One-click gas top-up for users, across EVM-compatible chains.
Incentivized Participation: Investors earn consistent returns by providing essential infrastructure for Web3 usability.
how_its_made:
Our protocol enables seamless cross-chain gas payments using USDC, powered by Coinbase’s Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP). When a user initiates a transaction, USDC is sent across chains via CCTP. The protocol then automatically estimates the required gas on the destination chain and uses the received USDC to purchase just enough gas for execution.

To support this mechanism, investors can provide capital and receive returns through our dividend-bearing token, "XFR". Profits generated from gas markups and usage fees are distributed to XFR holders.
